newsitem.title: USA: Discovery Zone emerges from bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: Discovery Zone emerges from bankruptcy.

text.p: Discovery Zone Inc., which operates children's play centres, said it emerged from bankruptcy protection from creditors Tuesday.

A group formed and led by the New York-based investment firm Wellspring Associates LLC raised $100 million to help back Discovery Zone's new business plan and acquired majority control of Discovery Zone, the company said.

A key component of Wellspring's strategy was recruiting a new senior management team led by president and chief executive officer Scott Bernstein, a former senior executive of Six Flags Theme Parks Inc. and Time Warner Inc.
In addition, Robert Rooney was appointed chief financial and administrative officer and Sharon Rothstein was named senior vice president of marketing and entertainment.

The next step will be to revitalise the company's outlets, the company said, noting it has set agreements with Pizza Hut and Pepsi-Cola for joint promotions and to provide food service to Discovery Zone play centres.
The company said it has also formed promotional alliances with Nerf, Toys R Us Inc., the World Wrestling Federation and New Line Cinema Corp.
